cases.title: Transport does not relocate machine State
Receipt is not a projection update
Honest scope and native status
evidence: distribution labels: host reference / native-device NOT_RUN

cases.title: Recover Pass-1 lineage
cases.exercise: Inspect local/remote refs and working tree.
cases.required_observation: Pass-1 commit or accepted successor preserved; no destructive reset.

cases.title: Run real baseline
cases.exercise: Run existing conformance and empty RAEON demos/tests.
cases.required_observation: Actual Genesis/Hypervisor execution; old empty topology reproduced.

cases.title: Keep writes scoped
cases.exercise: Inspect diff and upstream state before/after.
cases.required_observation: Only _raeon changed; _bricked remains pinned/read-only.

cases.title: Source-backed catalog
cases.exercise: Load accepted ordinary source records and resolve runtime handles.
cases.required_observation: Every runnable identity resolves to hashed source; no invented canonical names/effects.

cases.title: Validate normal roster
cases.exercise: Validate 60-card legal fixture and malformed counts.
cases.required_observation: Legal roster passes; wrong total/boolean/negative quantities fail without state change.

cases.title: FG copy limit
cases.exercise: Attempt 3 of an FG identity.
cases.required_observation: Rejected; 2 distinct copies allowed and not aliased.

cases.title: Utility copy limit
cases.exercise: Attempt 4 of an ordinary Utility identity.
cases.required_observation: Rejected; <=3 follows source data, not a per-color rule.

cases.title: Prime uniqueness
cases.exercise: Repeat a Prime identity in a roster.
cases.required_observation: Duplicate rejected; exact setup distribution not fabricated.

cases.title: Unknown catalog input
cases.exercise: Supply unknown, ambiguous or malformed IDs and hashes.
cases.required_observation: No fabricated record, silent default or runtime instance.

cases.title: Source preservation
cases.exercise: Hash FG catalog/atlas/protected source before and after.
cases.required_observation: Original corpus bytes unchanged; runtime aliases/indices are distinct derived data.

cases.title: Provisional metadata
cases.exercise: Load working Utility rank and printed-ID gaps.
cases.required_observation: Authority labels preserved; rank not inferred as cost or recovery count.

cases.title: Actual Genesis handlers
cases.exercise: Compile/verify/run every maintained Pass-2 .gen handler.
cases.required_observation: No decorative source or Python-only simulation claimed as integration.

cases.title: Deterministic compilation
cases.exercise: Rebuild at a second physical path with same logical inputs.
cases.required_observation: Same declared bytecode/content hashes; paths not semantic identity.

cases.title: Typed nonempty input
cases.exercise: Send card/zone/list arguments through the real adapter.
cases.required_observation: Validated bindings reach Genesis; client text never executed as source.

cases.title: Argument rejection
cases.exercise: Send extra fields, wrong numeric types, huge arrays and code-like strings.
cases.required_observation: Rejected before mutation; execution/memory limits preserved.

cases.title: Backward package compatibility
cases.exercise: Execute old conformance and Pass-1 package path.
cases.required_observation: Zero-argument observation and initial topology remain valid or explicit tested migration exists.

cases.title: Runtime instance growth
cases.exercise: Initialize both 60-card inventories plus original objects.
cases.required_observation: Bounded real native instances; not a two-card special case or unbounded verifier bypass.

cases.title: No rule logic in fence
cases.exercise: Inspect ownership and test bypass routes.
cases.required_observation: Hypervisor stays transport; gameplay checks executed through admitted Genesis/data semantics.

cases.title: Distinct copies
cases.exercise: Instantiate two of the same FG for each of two owners.
cases.required_observation: Same source record, four distinct live identities scoped to owner/match.

cases.title: Atomic inventory setup
cases.exercise: Initialize one validated roster under trusted grant.
cases.required_observation: Exactly 60 copies with exact multiset/order; existing Board identities preserved.

cases.title: No free spawn
cases.exercise: Try initialization through unauthorized player input after setup.
cases.required_observation: Rejected; no deck replacement or duplicated inventory.

cases.title: Idempotent initialization
cases.exercise: Resend identical setup and then conflicting setup.
cases.required_observation: Original result reused; conflicting reset rejected.

cases.title: Setup rollback
cases.exercise: Fail during staged card creation and before publication.
cases.required_observation: No partial inventory, counter advance or live leaked copy.

cases.title: Empty boot preserved
cases.exercise: Run empty application without initialization.
cases.required_observation: Pass-1 counts/identities/empty contents unchanged; capacity seven not an opening deal.

cases.title: Card-only containment
cases.exercise: Attempt non-CARD insertion into Deck/Hand/Graveyard.
cases.required_observation: Wrong profile rejected; container identity remains distinct.

cases.title: Ordered container identity
cases.exercise: Reorder collection and inspect copies.
cases.required_observation: Position changes never remint cards; order is explicit committed State.

cases.title: Shuffle golden vector
cases.exercise: Use fixed fixture seed/algorithm and independent permutation oracle.
cases.required_observation: Exact repeatable order and preserved multiset; no modulo-biased implementation shortcut.

cases.title: RNG durability
cases.exercise: Fail/retry and checkpoint mid-sequence.
cases.required_observation: RNG counter/order commit together; no extra random consumption on duplicate/refusal.

cases.title: Seed privacy
cases.exercise: Inspect player/opponent messages and normal intents.
cases.required_observation: No seed/future-order leakage or untrusted seed control.

cases.title: Top-card draw
cases.exercise: Issue admitted DRAW_ONE for an owned Deck/Hand.
cases.required_observation: Actual top copy moves; source count -1, Hand +1, same ID/history.

cases.title: Seven-card capacity
cases.exercise: Draw to seven, then attempt another.
cases.required_observation: Refusal leaves top/order/card multiset/root/revision/grant unchanged.

cases.title: Empty Deck
cases.exercise: Use declared exhausted-deck fixture and request draw.
cases.required_observation: Defined no-card/refusal; no invented match loss or auto-reshuffle.

cases.title: Unauthorized draw
cases.exercise: Forge owner, top card, destination or grant.
cases.required_observation: Rejected; no arbitrary tutor or foreign-card transfer.

cases.title: Concurrent stale transfer
cases.exercise: Submit two different requests for one source revision/card.
cases.required_observation: At most admitted successor commits; no duplicate/lost card.

cases.title: Order in semantic root
cases.exercise: Change Deck order via admitted shuffle.
cases.required_observation: Committed root reflects order/RNG; not only a mutable host list.

cases.title: FG Hand-to-space
cases.exercise: Commit an owned Hand FG into owned A.
cases.required_observation: Same logical copy/catalog; Hand removed, space added, EMPTY->CONFIGURING.

cases.title: No implicit field
cases.exercise: Commit several FGs with correct count only.
cases.required_observation: No active field/color/topology; pose and QMO gate deferred.

cases.title: Temporary capacity
cases.exercise: Attempt excess FG commitment into a capacity-3 temporary space.
cases.required_observation: Over-capacity denied without source loss.

cases.title: Committed extraction denied
cases.exercise: Attempt individual space-to-Hand or space-to-space movement.
cases.required_observation: Rejected; no backdoor via generic transfer.

cases.title: Wrong deployment profile/owner
cases.exercise: Commit Utility/Prime as FG or target opponent space.
cases.required_observation: Denied by admitted application contract.

cases.title: Prime structural slot
cases.exercise: Under setup fixture bind existing Prime to owned empty slot.
cases.required_observation: Distinct card/slot identity; no arithmetic or turn/setup rule invented.

cases.title: Prime slot denial
cases.exercise: Use occupied/foreign/fourth slot or wrong card profile.
cases.required_observation: Rejected atomically; existing slot/card untouched.

cases.title: Prime retirement denied
cases.exercise: Attempt normal Prime-to-Graveyard movement.
cases.required_observation: Denied; no invented destruction/deactivation in this pass.

cases.title: Cause-authorized retirement
cases.exercise: Retire eligible non-Primes under trusted resolved cause.
cases.required_observation: Copy/history conserved; explicit Graveyard order; no new discard/exile zone.

cases.title: No free retirement
cases.exercise: Request disposal/extraction with no valid cause.
cases.required_observation: Denied; test grant issuer is not a player export.

cases.title: Recover FG to Hand
cases.exercise: Use source-linked single-FG recovery with capacity available.
cases.required_observation: Exact same selected copy; no auto-topology reconstruction.

cases.title: Recover chosen order to Deck
cases.exercise: Use up-to-three non-Prime source effect with chosen order.
cases.required_observation: Selected order is next-draw order; Graveyard survivors preserve order.

cases.title: Recovery type restrictions
cases.exercise: Select wrong family/Prime/foreign/not-in-source copy.
cases.required_observation: Entire requested transfer rejected unchanged.

cases.title: Batch duplicate and overflow
cases.exercise: Repeat a selected copy or exceed batch/capacity.
cases.required_observation: All-or-none primitive refusal; no invented Utility overflow outcome or card consumption.

cases.title: Limited inspection
cases.exercise: Exercise granted Survey/Graveyard window; exceed count or reuse grant.
cases.required_observation: Only source-authorized selection visible; bounded scope/consumption.

cases.title: Source-vs-test distinction
cases.exercise: Exercise uncertain Utility timing/remainder behavior.
cases.required_observation: Explicit policy gate; helper success not claimed as full Utility implementation.
evidence: conformance-only fixture and no full Utility export

cases.title: Initial dynamic region
cases.exercise: Inspect empty initialization and live region representation.
cases.required_observation: Only A/B/C exist initially; extras absent, membership is not fixed to three.

cases.title: Three through nine
cases.exercise: Admit six additional spaces with canonical Sandbox Activation effects.
cases.required_observation: Live native space count grows 3..9; no Board reconstruction or unrelated machine domains.

cases.title: Reject tenth space
cases.exercise: Attempt one more admitted addition at cap.
cases.required_observation: No new space/grant consumption/partial relationships; semantic state unchanged.

cases.title: Permanent identity retention
cases.exercise: Compare Board, region and A/B/C through all additions.
cases.required_observation: All persistent identities unchanged; display positions not IDs.

cases.title: Capacity data-driven
cases.exercise: Exercise R/O/Y/G/B/V source definitions.
cases.required_observation: FG capacities 3/4/5/6/7/8 from source, not field-color creation.

cases.title: No color uniqueness
cases.exercise: Use two allowed copies of same-color Activation effect.
cases.required_observation: No invented one-per-color rule; global cap still enforced.

cases.title: No free expansion
cases.exercise: Forge rank/capacity, effect source, grant or other owner.
cases.required_observation: Denied; only bounded trusted admitted-effect path creates a space.

cases.title: Dynamic observation
cases.exercise: Read every added space through both authorized byte views.
cases.required_observation: New members included; stale manifest arrays do not cap visibility.

cases.title: Owner Hand visibility
cases.exercise: Inspect own Hand after real draws.
cases.required_observation: Authorized actual card identities/data visible.

cases.title: Opponent hidden information
cases.exercise: Inspect all snapshots/deltas/receipts/errors and cardbacks.
cases.required_observation: No hidden Hand or future Deck identities/order/seed revealed.

cases.title: Restricted Graveyard read
cases.exercise: Request arbitrary browse without accepted inspection effect.
cases.required_observation: Forbidden internals absent; grants permit only declared subset.

cases.title: Detached projection
cases.exercise: Modify decoded client dictionaries.
cases.required_observation: Native committed state unchanged.

cases.title: Conservation property sequence
cases.exercise: Run varied seeded admitted/refused operations for both owners.
cases.required_observation: After every step all card copies conserved; one live location each.

cases.title: Pre-publication failures
cases.exercise: Inject failure after source candidate update and before atomic publish.
cases.required_observation: Old root, order, memberships, grants, RNG and revision restored.

cases.title: Post-commit delivery failure
cases.exercise: Commit, drop output, retry same request.
cases.required_observation: Original outcome returned without a second transfer or revision.

cases.title: Request-ID conflict
cases.exercise: Reuse ID with changed arguments.
cases.required_observation: Conflict, not a replay of success and not another mutation.

cases.title: Stale/old epoch input
cases.exercise: Send out-of-date revision and pre-restart epoch.
cases.required_observation: No mutation; supported resynchronization path remains usable.

cases.title: Bounded queues/batches/resources
cases.exercise: Fill admission/output/resource limits.
cases.required_observation: Backpressure before publication; no lost accepted card action.

cases.title: Nonempty checkpoint
cases.exercise: Save varied zones, Deck order and nine-space membership.
cases.required_observation: Restore exact identities/order/catalog/grants/RNG/root, not a fresh empty match.

cases.title: Process restart/retry
cases.exercise: Restore in new process then retry committed request.
cases.required_observation: New boundary epoch, preserved outcome and zero duplicate mutation.

cases.title: Corrupt recovery data
cases.exercise: Tamper checkpoint/catalog/binding data.
cases.required_observation: Rejected unpublished candidate; no replace of valid live state.

cases.title: Replay semantic roots
cases.exercise: Repeat recorded operations with same declared input/namespace.
cases.required_observation: Equal semantic roots; host UUID/time/path differences excluded.

cases.title: Native route/closure negatives
cases.exercise: Remove valid path/grant or leave Portal/Road open.
cases.required_observation: Actual compiled integration fails; no direct host commit shortcut.

cases.title: Regression preservation
cases.exercise: Run runtime and Pass-1 behavioral suites with new bindings.
cases.required_observation: Prior behavior preserved; new runtime case count not a source-string test.

cases.title: Repository/QMO guards
cases.exercise: Run all applicable validators and regressions.
cases.required_observation: Original 120-FG/2,094-atlas source protection and canonical data preserved.

cases.title: Exact package inventory
cases.exercise: Package matching source revision and verify exact members/hashes.
cases.required_observation: Required .gen/catalog/runtime assets included; no caches/secrets/traversal/collisions.

cases.title: Offline no external checkout
cases.exercise: Build/run from isolated extraction without original repositories.
cases.required_observation: No external _bricked file/URL/Git dependency; provenance text allowed.
evidence: enforced Python audit hooks in every child interpreter

cases.title: Network/Git exclusion
cases.exercise: Deny/monitor network and Git for installed build/run paths.
cases.required_observation: No auto-fetch; record enforcement method, not just PIP_NO_INDEX.
evidence: enforced Python audit hooks in every child interpreter

cases.title: Fresh installed demos
cases.exercise: Run old and Pass-2 demos/tests/checkpoint using packaged dependencies.
cases.required_observation: Real Genesis+Hypervisor; explicit supported-host/Python prerequisite.

cases.title: Missing dependency fails closed
cases.exercise: Remove required asset in temporary test copy.
cases.required_observation: Clear dependency error; no online fallback.

cases.title: Receipt and denominator
cases.exercise: Produce mapped acceptance result and policy ledger.
cases.required_observation: Exact real counts; no NOT_RUN/FAIL silently marked PASS or removed.

cases.title: Commit/push/continuity
cases.exercise: Inspect final working tree, main and remote task ref.
cases.required_observation: Coherent _raeon commits pushed; main not merged; Pass-3 next command recorded.
